meta.title: Crucible — DX Infrastructure Platform
meta.description: Sync shared AI assistant configs across tools and repos with one command.

hero.headline: Your AI assistants don't talk to each other.
hero.subheadline: Crucible fixes that. Sync shared AI configs across tools and repos with one command.

scattered.title: 10 repos, 5 AI tools, 50 config files
scattered.description: Every repo has its own Claude rules, Cursor configs, Copilot instructions. Scattered, duplicated, drifting.

drift.title: Copy-paste. Drift. Outdated rules.
drift.description: Someone updates a skill in one repo. The other 9 repos are still on the old version. Nobody notices.

visibility.title: Nobody knows what's actually being used.
visibility.description: Which skills are active? Which are stale? No cross-tool visibility, no usage metrics, no feedback loop.

step1.title: Define skills in one repo
step1.description: Write AI skills, rules, and workflows in a central source repo. Convention-over-configuration — just put files in the right folder.

step2.title: forge sync distributes them
step2.description: One command fetches from your sources and places files for each AI tool in the right location, in the right format.

step3.title: Every tool gets the right config
step3.description: Automatic transforms: .md → .mdc for Cursor, .md → .instructions.md for Copilot. SHA-256 change detection. No unnecessary rewrites.

ecosystem.heading: The Crucible ecosystem

forge.name: Forge CLI
forge.description: Sync shared AI configs (skills, rules, workflows) across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, and Cline.

starter.name: Skills Platform
starter.description: Build, test, and deliver AI agent resources. Convention-over-configuration template for teams.

ember.name: Ember
ember.description: Cross-tool AI assistant observability. See how your skills are actually used. Your data never leaves your infrastructure.
